headline: No API change affects the bot today; the ideas are about catching tilt early: an alert when your entries speed up, a calm-or-heated check on tilt alerts, and a short review before the first trade after a tilt day.

ideas.title: Speed-up alert: entries coming faster
ideas.why: Revenge runs start as speed before they show up as losses. If three entries land inside 20 minutes, or your last gaps are under a third of your normal gap, the tilt guard pings you, win or lose. On 25 Oct you made 9 trades in an hour, which is this exact pattern.

ideas.title: Heat check button on every tilt alert
ideas.why: Each tilt alert asks one question with two buttons: "Calm" or "Heated" (fast breathing, tight jaw, thinking "I need to win it back"). Heated starts a 15-minute walk-away timer. /week shows how trades taken after a Heated tap turned out.

ideas.title: Review before trading the day after a tilt session
ideas.why: If yesterday had a tilt session, the 08:00 brief asks three short questions first: what set it off, the first sign, and what you'll do at that sign next time. The picks show after you answer, and today's trade cap is halved.

sources.title: Trading Tilt: Recognizing and Recovering from Emotional Flooding (TradesViz)
